note: The cells `cargo xtask equivalence` runs on a base and a candidate natively, one after the other: each a workload (scene: bench/scenes/NAME.json) or an authored scene (source: a file under web/scripts/fixtures/ or bench/) with its switches (options, as bench/options.json names them), environment sections merged over the scene's, the ticks it steps, its views (scene: as launched; a Stress Lab view; or {name, camera} with the camera control's fields) and its captures (exact; cpu:ALPHA and gpu:ALPHA, a fraction of the last tick presented on the CPU or the GPU; display:FRAMES, the last of that many ordinary frames). Every cell runs with bench/settings/default.json, job workers off and each side's own generated files. tolerance is the largest channel difference a pixel may show and count as equal (0 unless given). unstable lists the captures (VIEW CAPTURE) that vary from run to run, each with why: they pass when a candidate run matches one of the base's over --repeat runs, or lies no farther from the nearest than the base's own images lie from each other. not_toggled names the environment sections no cell's environment switches, each with why. The smoke tier runs by default; --tier full adds the rest. cargo xtask lint holds this file to the bench files and the Stress Lab.
